entries.6f9c3ed1caa8368f: The company operates a single segment, specializing in wholesale of business-use frozen foods. By business, Other Business, which includes side dishes and frozen vegetables, is the largest, followed by Boneless Fish Business and Meat Business. About 55% of products depend on partner factories overseas, of which about 40% are at production sites in China, so the company identifies as an issue the diversification of production through expanding its bases in Thailand and Vietnam and shifting part of production to Japan.
entries.70945c1ba6f8eb14: It sells to end users and wholesalers in Japan, including medical meal services, bento and catering businesses and restaurants. Storage and logistics are outsourced to external providers, and the company has built a delivery system that enables next-day delivery from a single case (1 case).
entries.7583b97362b313cf: This is the company's core business division, handling "boneless fish" from which all fish bones have been removed, for medical and nursing-care meals. The company succeeded in developing it in 1998 and holds four manufacturing patents for its processing technology. X-ray inspection for residual bones is carried out, and as of March 2026 it offers 32 fish species. Revenue by business for the fiscal year ended March 2026 was ¥8,713 million.
